# Patient RX System v2.0.57

Production hotfix for Google Drive-backed patient/RX document uploads in the compiled Windows executable.

## Fixed

- Replaced the document upload Google Drive runtime path with direct Drive REST API calls using Node.js built-in `fetch`.
- Avoided the packaged executable dynamic import failure from the `googleapis`/`gaxios` transport chain:
  `A dynamic import callback was not specified`.
- Preserved existing Drive folder organization under the configured root folder and existing local-storage fallback behavior.
- Kept Drive download/delete support working with compiled `server.exe` by converting Drive download Web streams into Node streams.

## Verification

- `node --check services/documentStorageService.js`
- Mocked Google Drive upload/download/delete cycle through `services/documentStorageService.js`
